cues: The play opens at dawn in the yard of Laxminarayan, the king's bull doctor, who is grumbling that not one of his seven wives has brought him his hookah.
The cowherds Jitman and Gore run in with the news: Male is dead.
All three are terrified; the king has threatened to punish anyone who lets the bull die.
